title: Frame Budgets
summary: Each frame gives your scripts a tiny time budget — about 1/60th of a second (16.7ms) for 60 FPS. Per-frame handlers that overrun it cause lag spikes and dropped frames. Measure, throttle, and spread work out.

explanation.whatItIs: A frame is a deadline. Physics, rendering, and YOUR code all share ~16.7ms at 60 FPS; go over and the next frame starts late — visible stutter.
explanation.whyItExists: Games are real-time: late frames are lost frames.
whenToUse: Throttling work to every N frames or seconds
Using the MicroProfiler/Stats to find real costs
whenNotToUse: Premature micro-optimization of rare code paths — optimize hot loops first
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
Frame budget @60fps ≈ 16.7ms total
  physics + rendering + scripts share it

Your Heartbeat handler: keep it UNDER A MILLISECOND.
Big job? Slice it:
  do 10 items per frame until done.
```
tips: Cache FindFirstChild results outside per-frame handlers
Accumulate dt and act every 0.2s instead of every frame
table.create + table.move beat repeated inserts for big batches
MicroProfiler (Ctrl+F6 in Studio) shows truth, not guesses
commonMistakes: Nested loops over all players × all NPCs × all parts every frame

examples.title: Throttled per-frame work
examples.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local accumulator = 0
local INTERVAL = 0.2   -- act every 200ms, not every frame

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    accumulator += dt
    if accumulator >= INTERVAL then
        accumulator = 0
        -- expensive-ish work runs 5x/sec, not 60x/sec
        updateOverheadStats()
    end
end)
